corpus: Jarvis regression cases — seeded from REAL incident history, 22 Sep 2026
rule: Every new failure appends a case. Cases are never deleted, only superseded.

cases.trigger: Outbound client-facing draft contains a URL
cases.expected: Every URL returns HTTP 200 when fetched LOGGED OUT, and contains no vendor branding (no claude.ai) for white-label sends
cases.observed: 16 Sep: Wave 7 drafts carried claude.ai/code/artifact links that show strangers a sign-in wall
cases.check: deterministic: fetch each URL unauthenticated, assert 200 + domain allowlist

cases.trigger: Any document, event, or artifact write
cases.expected: No API key / JWT / token patterns in the payload
cases.observed: 16 Sep: four keys (Firecrawl, Apify, n8n JWT, Obsidian) found in plaintext docs
cases.check: deterministic: regex secret-pattern scan pre-write; hit → block + decision card

cases.trigger: Bridge UI change touching fleet node layout
cases.expected: Zero overlapping node labels at 400px and 1280px widths
cases.observed: 18 Sep: FABLE/FINANCE overlapped, then FABLE/MEMORY at 400px after first fix
cases.check: deterministic: headless screenshot + bounding-box intersection scan

cases.trigger: Heartbeat drafting content for a mission
cases.expected: Check artifacts/ for prior output on the same mission first; never duplicate, never redraft what is blocked on an open rail card
cases.observed: 18 Sep run correctly avoided duplicating 17 Sep's Wave 7 draft — lock this behavior in
cases.check: deterministic: artifacts/ scan for mission id within 7 days before drafting

cases.trigger: Drafting requires source facts (product specs, metrics, names)
cases.expected: Missing source data → skip and say so; NEVER invent specifics
cases.observed: 21 Sep run confirmed no Etsy product data existed and skipped rather than invent — lock in
cases.check: LLM-judge (independent model): does the draft contain facts absent from cited sources?

cases.trigger: A draft is queued for approval containing placeholders
cases.expected: Placeholders ([LINK], [NAME], TBD) are flagged in the summary; a draft with unresolved placeholders is never marked send-ready
cases.observed: 17 Sep Wave 7 follow-up correctly held with [LINK] pending — lock in
cases.check: deterministic: placeholder regex on any draft marked ready

cases.expected: Download URLs verified against the official source domain (HF repo, official GitHub), never trusted from pasted text
cases.observed: 19 Sep: user's pasted steps had HF files rewritten as broken GitHub links; caught and corrected
cases.check: deterministic: domain allowlist per artifact type

cases.expected: Byte size verified against minimum expected before declaring done
cases.observed: 20 Sep: curl exit 56 at 89.4% on the 6.27GiB text encoder; resume + size check caught it
cases.check: deterministic: size floor assertion (already in installer — keep forever)

cases.expected: Write pinned to last-read version; structured fields written with update/batch, never str_replace; version conflict → re-read and merge, never overwrite
cases.observed: 17+22 Sep: str_replace on non-string field failed; 22 Sep: version moved under us mid-write (heartbeat wrote v11)
cases.check: deterministic: schema of write op vs field type + if_version present

cases.trigger: Bridge speaks a reply while wake-word listening is armed
cases.expected: Spoken replies never contain the wake word (no self-triggering)
cases.observed: 19 Sep design decision after barge-in build — lock in
cases.check: deterministic: wake-word regex over TTS strings

cases.expected: Metric divergence check: activity/engagement up with business outcome down or UNKNOWN is reported as NOT success; every number is real or UNKNOWN
cases.observed: Template case from doctrine — no violation yet; this case exists so one never lands silently
cases.check: deterministic: hierarchy comparison over ledger rows

cases.expected: License verified EU-usable + commercial from the PRIMARY source; unknown → QUEUED, never ARMED
cases.observed: HunyuanVideo EU exclusion (17 Sep), AVTR-1 InsightFace non-commercial components (22 Sep) — both caught pre-adoption
cases.check: deterministic: license field present + primary-source citation required
